name: 15631-batchdecode-qwen3next80b-tp4
model: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct, bf16, unquantized. NOT SUBSTITUTABLE. ~152 GB, already in the local HF cache, so nothing downloads.
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3 (SM90) of one a3 node (--gres=gpu:8, four used).
parallelism: TP=4, EP=1 (no expert parallelism), PP=1, DP=1. One node, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: Qwen3NextForCausalLM, 80B total / ~3B active MoE, bf16, 48 layers; ~160 GB of weights, ~37 GiB per rank at TP4. The rest is in the checkpoint's config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 256 requests with a 1200 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix structure: 1024 prompt tokens in, 1024 generated out, both fixed (stdev 0), `ignore_eos` true and `temperature` 0.0 so every request generates the full 1024 tokens. Radix cache off, so every request prefills cold and nothing is reused. Seed 15631.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant on an 80-billion-parameter model, serving 64 concurrent users full-page answers across four GPUs.
launch:
# The engine's command line. FLAT PARSER: one `key: value` per line, and an indented
# continuation is skipped silently -- a structured value must stay on one line.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct
tp-size: 4
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
max-running-requests: 64
disable-radix-cache: true
chunked-prefill-size: 8192

# Graph capture stays on, with one captured decode batch: padding is on by default, so every
# decode batch of 64 or fewer replays this graph and the decode shape is constant for the run.
cuda-graph-max-bs: 64
cuda-graph-bs: [64]

random-seed: 15631
